posts.text:
Mina built her first agentic loop. Token had other plans.

Endless Loop

https://sorrytomorrow.com/comics/endless-loop/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=comic-023-endless-loop&utm_content=panels

media.alt: Mina proudly explains her first agentic loop: Token will build the website, test, fix and repeat. Dex points at the laptop and tells him to get started. Tiny Token sits on books looking out at the Ferris wheel.

A wordless strip shows tiny Token skipping out of the office with a ride ticket, beside an adult shoe for scale. Below, a complete illuminated Ferris wheel has Token joyfully riding in a visibly attached gondola: “WEEEE!” Defeated Dex holds a laptop showing TESTS FAILED and says, “He refuses to get off the loop.” Mina facepalms; unbothered Wes wears a plush duck hat and eats a rainbow snow cone. An attendant gestures from the exit.
